$comment: The bake-off's scenario, carried into this repository unchanged except for this line and the two dropped members. It was generated on 2026-09-05 by the fixture generator of the experiment recorded in docs/experiments/2026-09-05-assistant-engine-bakeoff, which lives in that experiment's own record and NOT in this repository — the ADR says so, and an earlier version of this line named a path here that does not exist. What the generator did is what matters and is checkable from the documents themselves: DRAFT_V1 is refused by `jpack spec validate` and DRAFT_V2 is accepted, and an experimental evaluate of DRAFT_V2 over FACTS succeeds — which conformance.test.ts asserts against the recorded runtime answers in runtime.json on every leg. criticSteps and proofFile are dropped: the refutation pass is chunk 4, and the proof file lives in the experiment's record.
policy: Expense reimbursement. A claim of 50 USD or less is approved. A claim above 50 USD is approved only when a receipt is attached; without one it is declined. Any claim above 1000 USD is escalated to finance instead of being decided.
unknowns: The policy fixes the thresholds in USD but does not say what to do with a claim denominated in another currency; the pack reads /claim/amount as a decimal string and assumes the caller has already converted it.
"above 50" and "above 1000" are read as strictly greater-than, so a claim of exactly 1000.00 is decided here rather than escalated. The policy does not say.

Whether a receipt is attached is supplied as the prepared fact /claim/receiptAttached. The pack declares a `receipt` evidence requirement as a citation only (required: false) — nothing in the pack checks that the attached document is itself a valid receipt.
